biggest_catch: The referral terms are dated 31 August 2024 — two years old — though the PDF is still live on Share Energy's own media host; the scheme can be suspended or modified at any time without notice, so confirm the £20 credit is still offered before sharing. Only Northern Ireland residents can participate.
catches: Terms & conditions are dated 31/08/2024; the PDF is still live but Share Energy reserves the right to suspend, modify, or terminate the scheme at any time without notice.
Only existing Share Energy customers who are residents of Northern Ireland aged 18+ can refer; employees and their immediate families are excluded.
The referred customer must not be an existing customer or have been one within the last 12 months.
The referral code must be used at the referral's signup — retrospective applications are not accepted.
A maximum of 5 credits per billing period; additional credits roll over to the next billing period.
The £20 credit or top-up cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred to another person.
Credit is applied within 30 days of the successful switch.
Rewards offset planned electricity spending (savings), never income.
The £20 figure seen in older terms was a January 2026 limited-time boost; the current standing scheme pays £15 per side.

steps: As an existing Share Energy customer (Northern Ireland, 18+), receive your unique referral code.
Share your referral code with friends or family interested in switching electricity supplier.
The referred customer signs up with Share Energy using your code and completes the switch.
Within 30 days of the successful switch, a £20 credit or top-up is applied to both your accounts.
